stories.headline: Democrats win control of both chambers of Congress
stories.summary: Reuters and AP report Democratic majorities in the House and Senate following Tuesday's election. Several races remain unresolved and totals are not certified. The new Congress takes office in January.

stories.headline: OCC tells bank examiners how to assess AI risk
stories.summary: New OCC guidance focuses on consequences, autonomy and oversight rather than treating AI as a separate risk category, Reuters reports. Higher-risk uses can warrant tighter controls. Guidance is not a binding rule.

stories.headline: AMD data-center sales nearly double
stories.summary: AMD's third-quarter data-center revenue rose 97% to $8.55 billion. Management forecasts more than 80% overall revenue growth in 2027. The earnings are reported results; the growth outlook remains a company forecast.

stories.headline: Iran claims tankers hit mines near Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says four tankers struck mines south of Hormuz and two other vessels were seized. Reuters reports the claim; vessel identities, casualties and independent confirmation remain unavailable.

stories.headline: Russia reports strikes on Ukrainian power stations
stories.summary: Russia says it hit power stations in Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions. Ukrainian officials report strikes elsewhere as energy attacks continue ahead of planned peace talks. Details remain dependent on official accounts.
